name: AMD Instinct MI300X product page
notes: Live AMD product page. Spec table gives all dense + structured-sparse figures, and footnotes MI300-17/18/05A state the derivations (including '8,192 bits x 5.2 Gbps / 8 = 5.325 TB/s'). Comparison charts quote NVIDIA sparse numbers without halving them, so read the footnotes, not the bar charts.
